First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:15 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 10–16+ mph: you can talk the whole way. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wheels of Color Thursday Night Ride Therapy group ride

Wheels of Color Thursday Night Ride Therapy is a road group ride in Columbus, OH. It rolls every Thursday at 6:15 pm from Michaels – Easton (south parking lot).

A Thursday ride run by Wheels of Color, a Columbus cycling crew that rides alongside Major Taylor and Black Girls Do Bike groups. Road and trail options with multiple paces; road loops run 15 to 35 miles.
